text:
elaine: Repro: sample app fails when function-calling + json_mode + auth refresh. Parser errors only after the SDK retries mid-stream.

noah: can you paste the smallest log? this smells like the stream validator running early.

elaine: log snippet:
```
POST /v1/chat {json_mode:true, function_call:true}
chunk1: '{"order": [{"id":"o1","items":[{"sku":"X'
validator runs -> throws
chunk2: '-100","qty":2}]}],"meta":{}}'
```
Error happens when refresh -> retry reuses buffer and chunks get concatenated.

kevin: JS SDK's stream-validator triggers on every data event. Py waits for final chunk. parity gap.

elaine: repro (node):
```
const c = new RW();
await c.chat.generate({json_mode:true, stream:true, function_call:true, authRefresh:true});
// force token refresh during stream
```
Link: https://git.redwood/devex/repros/fncall-json-retry (private)

noah: short-term fixes: 1) guard when braces/balanced before running Ajv, 2) add `x-rw-final-chunk` header on server, or 3) support NDJSON emitting one object per line.

kevin: I'll ship a tiny helper `jsonMode.streamGuard()` that buffers until braces balanced or up to 64kb then validates. Will add telemetry when fallback hits.

bot-ci: canary: js-sdk/0.12.6-rc (unit ok, int pending)

elaine: good. please docs note: "If you see schema errors only during retries/auth-refresh, enable NDJSON or upgrade to 0.12.6-rc."

noah: long-term: add parity tests (auth-retry x stream x sdk) and consider len-prefix framing. Filing tasks: DEVEX-2201, DEVEX-2202.

kevin: PR: https://git.redwood/devex/sdk-js/pulls/450 (wip) - includes guard + test for auth-refresh mid-stream.

elaine: thx, I'll re-run onboarding sample after canary passes and post traces.
